text_block_list.text:
Before the Japanese Derby, the
participating
Umamusume gather for a
press conference to talk
about their
thoughts leading up to the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though the other participants are
brimming with
excitement and nerves,
Grass Wonder alone gives
calm,
collected responses.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса sees through Grass
Wonder's
polite facade, and comes by
after the interviews
to challenge her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер's fighting spirit burns
quietly as we
further prepare for the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
